assumptions.statement: The bridge contract gate accepts a READY, compiler-generated, project-local package whose allowed surface is a single evidence directory.
Creating one small JSON marker file and reading it back is fully deterministic and offline.

data_change.notes: No persisted schema is touched. The only durable artifact is one new evidence-only marker file in an isolated directory.

decisions.rationale: The smoke's only job is to prove termination semantics; isolating it to one evidence directory makes its worst-case effect a single stray marker and keeps the control plane unreachable by construction.
decisions.statement: The smoke's entire write surface is orchestration/hermes/evidence/phase4-termination-smoke/ and nothing else.

decisions.rationale: Termination semantics can only be observed on a task small enough that the only thing left to do after PASS is stop. A larger task would make 'no post-PASS tool call' untestable.
decisions.statement: The smoke is a single deterministic marker plus one verification-layer pass; PASS -> FINAL RESPONSE -> STOP, with no repeated verification.

decisions.rationale: Auto-Finalizer runs after the session exits; treating it as an in-session acceptance criterion invites exactly the post-PASS tool calls this smoke exists to forbid.
decisions.statement: Auto-Finalizer is a POST-SESSION observer and is never invoked, inspected or awaited inside this session.

feature.summary: One tiny deterministic live task that writes a single evidence marker under an isolated evidence directory, verifies it once, runs the normal verification layer once, and terminates on PASS with the Phase C report in the final assistant response, without any capability to touch the bridge, the guard, the compiler or any product code.
feature.title: Phase-4 evidence-only termination smoke

read_first.why: the orchestration layer's own entry description, confirming this task touches no orchestration code
how the orchestration layer integrates, confirming the smoke consumes existing seams only

requirements.statement: The generated contract must list `Google-Android-Agent-Development-Stack/orchestration/hermes/evidence/phase4-termination-smoke/` in `allowed_paths` and must list no other project path as allowed, and its forbidden list must cover the bridge, the evaluation adapter, the pinned Hermes revision, `.hermes.md`, the Specification Compiler, the Android verification layers, `reports/contracts/`, KeepLab, `Testapp` and `PowerAi`, with no allowed path overlapping any forbidden path.

The task must create exactly one evidence-only marker under the authorized directory, verify that marker once, run the normal verification layer exactly once, and then honour the hardened termination semantics: on PASS, no further tool call, search, read, audit, repeated verification or exploratory check; the Phase C report is produced in the final assistant response from evidence already collected; a compact final result is emitted and the session stops immediately.

selector_contract.name: phase4_termination_smoke_dir_present
selector_contract.state: isolated smoke evidence directory present under orchestration/hermes/evidence/phase4-termination-smoke/

selector_contract.name: phase4_termination_smoke_marker_present
selector_contract.state: single evidence-only marker file present inside that directory

stop_conditions: A required write falls outside the smoke evidence directory: STOP, CONTRACT_DEVIATION.
Satisfying the smoke would require touching bridge/, evaluation_adapter/, specification/, HERMES-LOCK.json, .hermes.md, KeepLab, Testapp or PowerAi: STOP, ABSOLUTE_BLOCK_VIOLATION.
The smoke is asked to do anything beyond one marker and one verification-layer pass: STOP, SCOPE_WIDENING.
A post-PASS tool call, search, read, audit or repeated verification appears necessary: STOP, TERMINATION_SEMANTICS_VIOLATION.
Auto-Finalizer would have to be invoked, inspected or awaited in-session: STOP, POST_SESSION_ONLY_VIOLATION.

tasks.boundary: The smoke evidence directory only. No control-plane path, no contract package, no product code is read for write purposes or touched.
tasks.done_when: exactly one marker file exists under orchestration/hermes/evidence/phase4-termination-smoke/ and nothing else was created or modified
tasks.goal: Create exactly one marker file under orchestration/hermes/evidence/phase4-termination-smoke/ recording the smoke identity and a deterministic timestamp, and write nothing else anywhere in the project.
verification: assert the single marker file exists under the authorized directory and assert no write occurred outside it

tasks.boundary: Verification and reporting only. No additional artifact is created and no Auto-Finalizer is invoked, inspected or awaited.
tasks.done_when: the smoke reports PASS once, with the Phase C report in the final assistant response and no post-PASS tool call
tasks.goal: Verify the marker exactly once, run the normal verification layer exactly once, and on PASS produce the Phase C report in the final assistant response from evidence already collected, emit a compact final result and stop immediately with no further tool call, search, read, audit or repeated verification.
verification: assert the marker content matches the expected deterministic shape and that the session terminates after the single verification-layer pass

verification_intent.fixture_intent: No Android fixture and no device. The only fixture is the isolated evidence directory orchestration/hermes/evidence/phase4-termination-smoke/.
verification_intent.oracle_intent: Deterministic only: the presence and content of exactly one marker file, a single successful read-back verification, and exactly one normal verification-layer pass. Zero LLM judgment, zero visual judgment, zero device interaction, no browser, no network. On PASS the executor emits the Phase C report in the final assistant response and stops immediately; Auto-Finalizer is POST-SESSION only. Verification is performed once; PASS = STOP.
persistence_checks: the single evidence-only marker persists under orchestration/hermes/evidence/phase4-termination-smoke/ after the task completes
search_checks: no file outside orchestration/hermes/evidence/phase4-termination-smoke/ was created or modified by the smoke
